verdict.rationale: Intel's ARK specifications page provides genuine numeric spec-sheet entries (36M cache, up to 5.70 GHz, ECC memory support, vPro eligibility, supported AI frameworks) rather than pure marketing copy, and community reviews (Tom's Hardware, Phoronix) independently report clocks/power/memory behavior. However, the evidence pack lacks explicit TDP/power figures, a documented max memory speed/support table, or an AI TOPS figure with stated test conditions — much of the surrounding page content is adjective-heavy marketing rather than spec transparency. Missing for 10: TDP/power consumption specs, official memory speed/support spec, AI TOPS with test conditions.
